subject: Request: Senior authorization for exceptional Hosted API rate cut (Medexa)
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@medexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing -- pilot ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Medexa is excited about evaluating Redwood's Hosted API for our document ingestion and triage workflows.

Quick ask from procurement: to make the pilot financially viable we need a substantial off-list rate. We're targeting a 12-month engagement, initial committed usage ~ $150k/month (estimated 8M tokens/mo). Can Redwood accommodate a 30-35% discount on standard Hosted API unit rates for the first 12 months?

If you need a formal MOP or ARR estimate we've attached our internal forecast to the procurement thread. We're hoping to get a written sense of what approvals are required and whether you can provide pricing before the end of next week.

Appreciate it —
Sara Holt
Director, Strategic Procurement
Medexa Health
procurement@medexa.com

[Attachment: Medexa_MOP_v1.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Holt <sara.holt@medexa.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing -- pilot ask / Request for senior authorization >20%

Mina / Steph — forwarding Medexa's request (below). Bottom line: they want 30-35% off list for a 12-month commit (~$150k/mo).

Why I think this is strategic:
- Referenceable healthcare customer, multi-region rollout planned in 2028.
- Pilot could convert to full production within 6–9 months if perf and PII controls meet their bar.
- They requested private deployment later but want to start on Hosted API for speed.

Deal economics (requested concession):
- Forecasted committed spend: $1.8M over 12 months.
- Requested discount: 30–35% off Hosted API list rates for first 12 months.
- Proposed Redwood ask: approve up to 30% for a bounded term; include ramp commitments and trial termination clauses.

Recommended approval path (my proposal):
1) Exec approval for up to 30% off list rates for a 9-month term (30% months 1–9), then revert to 15% for months 10–12 while they ramp activity.
2) Require signed SOW + DocuSign rate card before discount takes effect.
3) Legal to include usage caps and data residency clauses; Finance to sign off on recognition schedule.
4) Record concession in Deal Desk and set automatic alert at 75% of committed spend.

Attachments: Medexa_MOP_v1.pdf, Medexa_ARR_Model.xlsx (forwarding their files).

Ask: Can you authorise up to 30% for a bounded period (I can write the proposed term language)? If yes, I'll send a conditional offer to Medexa and loop Legal/Finance for finalization.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Ben / Mina — thanks for the summary. Quick thoughts:

- I'm comfortable with an exception in the 25–30% range for a strategic healthcare pilot, provided we limit the discounted pricing to a defined term and secure a firm commit.
- Preferable structure: 30% for 6–9 months (we should pick conservatively), then 15% for the remainder of the 12-month period.
- Require an explicit committed spend figure and a clause that discounts terminate if they exceed agreed usage profile (to avoid runaway credits).
- Legal must validate SOW and rate-card language; Finance needs to confirm revenue recognition / rebate treatment.

Please add Legal@redwood and FinanceOps to the thread for redlines after we pick exact term length. Also include the proposed Deal Desk entry fields (effective dates, rate override code, owner).

If you can get me a short proposed term (e.g., 30% for 9 months, 15% for last 3 months) I will escalate to Mina for final sign-off.

-Stephanie
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing -- pilot ask / Request for senior authorization >20%

Ben / Steph — after reviewing the numbers and strategic fit, I approve an executive exception as follows:

- Authorization: 30% discount off standard Hosted API rates.
- Term: 9 months at 30%, followed by 3 months at 15% (total 12 months).
- Conditions:
  * Signed SOW + DocuSign rate card required before discount applies.
  * Finance must confirm revenue recognition schedule; do not book revenue until DocuSign executed.
  * Legal to insert standard usage cap and termination clauses; any PII/residency requirements must be documented.
  * Deal Desk entry with concession reason code: "Strategic Healthcare Pilot — Exec 30pct".

Ben — please prepare the conditional offer language (I want the DocuSign package by end of day Monday). Also attach the approved rate card PDF when you send to Medexa.

I'll sign off on the record once Legal/Finance confirm the final SOW.

Mina Haddad
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
